         These accessibility behaviors are new.
     •   When you specify displayReadOnlyIcon: true and editable:false , the lock icon now
         displays inside a <span> element that contains aria-label="Locked Column Name" and
         role="image" , where Column Name refers to the label that you define for the column.
     • The <span> element that contains assistive text for the lock icon has been removed.

lightning:input
        The calendar on the input fields of type date and datetime have these accessibility changes.
     • The <select> element for month and year selections now specify the aria-describedby
         attribute. The <div> element that specifies role="status" contains an empty <div>
         element. When a field-level error occurs, the element renders assistive text for screen readers.
     • The tabindex attribute has been moved from the <td> elements on the calendar to the day
         buttons, which are inner <span> elements that specify role="button" .
     • The aria-selected , aria-current , and aria-disabled attributes have been moved to
         the inner <span> element that specifies role="button" .

Salesforce Release Notes                                                                     Development

         role="button" , which indicates day month year, button . For example: 8 October

        position. A timeout can occur due to factors such as browser security settings, network

Create, update, or delete record data with mutations (generally available)
        GraphQL mutations, which is now generally available, includes some changes since the beta
        release.
     • The RecordUpdatePayload type includes a Record field that defines the fields that you want
        the response to return. For example, use this mutation query to update a contact record and
        specify the ID and name fields that you want the response to return.

          mutation ContactUpdateExample{
            uiapi {
              ContactUpdate(input: {
                Contact: {
                      FirstName: "Sam"
                      LastName: "Smith"
                    }
                    Id: "003RM000008AAAAAA4"
                  }) {
                    Record {
                       Id
                       FirstName {
                           value
                       }
                       LastName {
                           value
                       }
                    }
                  }
              }
          }


        This is the example response.

          {
              "data": {
                "uiapi": {
                  "ContactUpdate": {
                    "Record": {
                      "Id": "003RM000008AAAAAA4",
                      "FirstName": {
                         "value": "Sam"
                      },




                                                   236
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                 Development



                            "LastName": {
                              "value": "Smith"
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
              },
              "errors": []
          }


        Previously, the RecordUpdatePayload included a success field that returned true or
         false .
     • Mutations are available via the GraphQL wire adapter. Use the new executeMutation method
        from the lightning/graphql module. See New and Changed Modules for Lightning Web
        Components for more information.


Update the last viewed date on records that you query
       Query objects with the new updateMRU argument set to true , which also updates the
         LastViewedDate field on the records that are returned.


        This example queries accounts with their IDs and names. The query also updates the
         LastViewedDate fields on the account records.

          query accounts {
            uiapi {
              query {
                Account (updateMRU:true){
                  edges {
                    node {
                      Id
                      Name {
                         value
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }


        This is the example response.

          {
              "data": {




                                                 237
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                 Experience Cloud



                  "uiapi": {
                    "query": {
                      "Account": {
                        "edges": [
                          {
                             "node": {
                               "Id": "0015f000007wCAWAA2",
                               "Name": {
                                 "value": "Enfield Tennis Academy"
                               }
                             }
                          },
                          {
                             "node": {
                               "Id": "0015f000007vRRVAA2",
                               "Name": {
                                 "value": "Ennet House"
                               }
                             }
                          }

  Submit Records for Approval by Using the Request Approval Component
  Your credentialed site visitors can now submit records for approval directly from your site. Add the
  Request Approval component to an object detail page. Then configure the component to require
  submitters to select an approver and add comments about their request. The Request Approval
  component works only with Flow Approval Processes, not with Classic Approval Processes.

accessible to screen readers with aria-* attributes.

  Simplify Custom Domain Management with a Stable Target Host Name
  If a third party serves your custom domain and your org uses Salesforce Edge Network, reduce your
  effort and the risk of downtime during Salesforce maintenance. Work with your third-party provider to
  update the domain’s target host name to your org’s My Domain login URL, which continues to work

Simplify Custom Domain Management with a Stable Target Host Name

This release is in preview

Note: This release is in preview. Features described in this document don't become generally available
until the latest general availability date that Salesforce announces for this release. Before then, and
where features are noted as beta, pilot, or developer preview, we can't guarantee general availability
within any particular time frame or at all. Make your purchase decisions only on the basis of generally
available products and features.

If a third party serves your custom domain and your org uses Salesforce Edge Network, reduce your effort
and the risk of downtime during Salesforce maintenance. Work with your third-party provider to update
the domain’s target host name to your org’s My Domain login URL, which continues to work when your
Salesforce instance changes. The current target host name works until your instance name or Hyperforce
cell changes. We recommend that you update the target host name before your next org migration.

Where: This change applies to Salesforce Sites and Aura, LWR, and Visualforce sites accessed through
Lightning Experience and Salesforce Classic in Enterprise, Performance, and Unlimited editions. This
change applies only to custom domains with the domain configuration “Use a third-party service or CDN
to serve the domain.”

Why: Custom domains serve your Digital Experiences or Salesforce Sites on a domain that you own, such
as https://www.example.com. When a third-party service or content delivery network (CDN) serves
your custom domain, the target host name routes your domain traffic to your Salesforce org. If that host
name changes, your custom domain stops working until your third party updates the domain
configuration to match.

Until you update your target host name to your My Domain URL, that host name contains your Salesforce
instance or Hyperforce cell, which can change during an org migration. My Domain login URLs continue
to work when those values change.

How: To get the target host name for your custom domain, in Setup, find and select Domains. Then click
the name of your domain.




                                                   250
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                  Experience Cloud




Work with your third-party provider to update the domain’s target host name to the value in the Target
Host Name field.

using the migrated domain.

Salesforce Files

This release is in preview

Note: This release is in preview. Features described in this document don't become generally available
until the latest general availability date that Salesforce announces for this release. Before then, and
where features are noted as beta, pilot, or developer preview, we can't guarantee general availability
within any particular time frame or at all. Make your purchase decisions only on the basis of generally
available products and features.

With the new Scan files for viruses or malware (beta) setting, users are blocked from uploading or
downloading malicious files. The file size limit has increased from 2 GB to 10 GB. And to keep your files
list organized and tidy, you can now enable more users to delete files that they don’t own. Several of
these features are ones that you requested on IdeaExchange.

  Protect Your Salesforce Org and Users by Scanning Files for Malware (Beta)
  For improved security in your Salesforce org, files are now scanned for malware in Salesforce Files.
  When a user tries to upload a file, the process is blocked if the scanned file is malicious. If a malicious
  file is uploaded via the API, it’s scanned asynchronously, and it appears in the new Malicious Files
  (Beta) list. When a user attempts to download an existing file, the download is blocked if it’s malicious.
  This feature was developed based on your idea on IdeaExchange.
  Manage Files up to 10 GB in Salesforce Files
  Salesforce Files has increased the file size limit from 2 GB to 10 GB. The increased limit is available to
  Files home, libraries, and on a record’s Files related list, but not to files uploaded to Chatter or LWR
  sites in Experience Cloud.
  Allow More Users to Delete Files
  Manage files in Salesforce more efficiently by assigning the new Delete Salesforce Files permission to
  your users. With this permission, a user can delete any file that they have access to view. Previously,
  only a Salesforce admin or the file owner could delete a file. This feature was developed based on your
  idea on IdeaExchange.

     Note Scan files for viruses or malware is a pilot or beta service that is subject to the Beta Services

When: This functionality is available on a rolling basis starting in Spring ’26. For details about timing and

Who: File owners, or users who have access to a file that was shared with them, can view a file even if it’s
malicious. To access the Malicious Files (Beta) list and all identified malicious files or to download
malicious files, you need the Manage Malicious Files (Beta) user permission. To only download malicious
files, you need the Download Malicious Files (Beta) user permission.

How: From Setup, in the Quick Find box, enter Files, and then select Salesforce Files | General
Settings. The setting Scan files for viruses or malware (beta) is turned on by default. If a new file isn’t
scanned during the initial upload, it’s scanned asynchronously and added to the Malicious Files List
(Beta) if it contains malware.

Enhanced Scheduling and Optimization

This release is in preview

Note: This release is in preview. Features described in this document don't become generally available
until the latest general availability date that Salesforce announces for this release. Before then, and
where features are noted as beta, pilot, or developer preview, we can't guarantee general availability
within any particular time frame or at all. Make your purchase decisions only on the basis of generally
available products and features.

Benefit from advanced features and better schedule quality with Enhanced Scheduling and
Optimization.

  Optimize Large Datasets in One Smooth Operation with Dynamic Scaling (Generally Available)
  Set up and manage large-scale global and in-day optimization effectively without splitting data due to
  system limits. Dynamic scaling intelligently structures data into geographical clusters, seamlessly
  balancing demand and capacity while accounting for all operational work rule constraints. This
  capability simplifies optimization management by enabling higher system limits, so you don’t need to
  manually define optimization groups and boundaries. It also prevents conflicts and overlaps that often
  occur with fragmented, parallel optimization runs. You can now easily select all service territories when
  you configure a scheduled optimization job without having to select each territory individually.
  Previously, you had to define boundaries between areas that needed to be optimized together, making
  workforce planning difficult. Lower system limits meant you had to reduce the number of service
  appointments or service resources processed in a single request, and configure multiple optimization
  jobs. This fragmentation was tedious and affected overall business performance.
  Get More Optimal Scheduling with Updated Service Objective Scoring Formulas



                                                   264
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                       Field Service


  Achieve improved scheduling outcomes that match your business priorities with refined grading
  formulas that better reflect your configured service objective weights. The Same Site objective now
  has a much larger impact on the scheduling outcome. The impact of the Skill Preference and Skill
  Level objectives has doubled. And, the Resource Priority objective now relies on a fixed scale of 1 to 10
  instead of the priority values sent in each optimization request, so that the schedule outcome is more
  predictable. Previously, some underlying calculations reduced the intended impact of an objective's
  assigned weight.
  Access Optimization Request Files on Your Own (Generally Available)
  Use Optimization Request Files to retrieve the request and response files of an optimization request.
  Review the files in a JSON format to find out what happened to a specific request and quickly resolve
  related issues. Previously, you had to open a Support case and wait to get the files, which delayed the
  troubleshooting process.
  Get More Transparency into Service Operation Inefficiencies with Rule Violation Analytics (Beta)
  Understand the root causes of rule violations in manual scheduling, such as geographical imbalances
  or skill gaps, and make data-driven decisions by analyzing trends and patterns. Rule Violation
  Analytics, built on the Enhanced Scheduling and Optimization Data Model, captures all rules that are
  manually violated on the Gantt. Easily query this data via a semantic data model and draw insights by
  creating a comprehensive dashboard in Tableau Next. Visualize rule violations, track metrics like the
  frequency of specific rule violations, and identify dispatchers or territories with recurring issues.
  Proactively address inefficiencies for better resource allocation, workforce planning, and dispatcher
  training.

Note: This release is in preview. Features described in this document don't become generally available

Give your mobile workers complete visual context for improved performance by displaying multiple
related images directly within the Data Capture form, even when offline. The new Multiple Image
Preview component can link to a record and access all images associated with it. Mobile workers can
review images from previous jobs, and add images to the record after the form is created. They can
preview thumbnails, zoom in on details, and swipe through a full-screen carousel of site photos.

created.

Where: This feature is available in Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer editions,
and in the Field Service mobile app for Android and iOS .

How: In Flow Builder, add the Multiple Image Preview component to a screen and configure it to display
images by linking to a record, such as a work order. You can define the maximum number of thumbnails
to display. To enable offline viewing, make sure that the related records and images are primed using
Briefcase Builder. The form must be loaded at least once while online, and all images must be loaded
before the images can be accessed offline.

Note: This release is in preview. Features described in this document don't become generally available

Products and features from Data 360, Marketing Cloud, Platform, MuleSoft, and Tableau Cloud are now
available in more Hyperforce regions. Hyperforce Assistant introduced a new way to find hard-coded
references. The Hyperforce public IP ranges now include addresses for inbound connections, in addition
to existing outbound addresses. Prepare for IPv6 if you use IP allowlists.

  Access Salesforce in More Regions with Hyperforce
  Hyperforce is available in 17 countries, giving you more choice and control over data residency.
  Find Hard-Coded References Using the Updated Hyperforce Assistant Process
  The automated check previously available in step one of Hyperforce Assistant has been replaced due
  to updates in underlying tools. The remaining Hyperforce Assistant features remain unchanged.
  Hyperforce Assistant helps customers prepare their org for migration. Because your org’s instance
  changes during migration, hard-coded references cause functionality failures post-migration. Finding
  and resolving hard-coded references during the preparation phase enables applications to maintain
  correct functionality after the upgrade to Hyperforce.
  Hyperforce Public IP Ranges Now Include Inbound Addresses
  The Hyperforce public IP address ranges have been expanded to include inbound addresses for traffic
  to your Salesforce org. Previously, these ranges contained IP addresses only for connections from
  Salesforce to the customer network. Now, these ranges also contain IP addresses for inbound
  connections to your Salesforce org. Salesforce recommends adopting modern security practices, such
  as mTLS, instead of allowlisting on Hyperforce. But for customers with an insurmountable business or
  compliance requirement to use allowlists, Salesforce provides Hyperforce public IP ranges in JSON
  format.
  Prepare for IPv6 in Hyperforce Public IPs
  If you use an IP allowlist to restrict network traffic or you restrict access to Salesforce via IP address,
  prepare to update your allowlists to include IPv6 addresses.

Hyperforce Public IP Ranges Now Include Inbound Addresses

This release is in preview

Note: This release is in preview. Features described in this document don't become generally available
until the latest general availability date that Salesforce announces for this release. Before then, and
where features are noted as beta, pilot, or developer preview, we can't guarantee general availability
within any particular time frame or at all. Make your purchase decisions only on the basis of generally
available products and features.

The Hyperforce public IP address ranges have been expanded to include inbound addresses for traffic to
your Salesforce org. Previously, these ranges contained IP addresses only for connections from Salesforce
to the customer network. Now, these ranges also contain IP addresses for inbound connections to your
Salesforce org. Salesforce recommends adopting modern security practices, such as mTLS, instead of
allowlisting on Hyperforce. But for customers with an insurmountable business or compliance
requirement to use allowlists, Salesforce provides Hyperforce public IP ranges in JSON format.

Where: This change applies to all Salesforce orgs that manage connectivity using IP allowlists, including
those on Hyperforce and on first-party infrastructure. These ranges support products built on the
Salesforce platform, including Sales, Service, and Industries clouds, as well as Tableau and the MuleSoft
Anypoint Platform. These addresses are not for email, and not for Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, or
Slack.

How: Access the Hyperforce public IP address ranges at https://ip-ranges.salesforce.com/ip-
ranges.json.

See Also
  Knowledge Article: Hyperforce IPs to Allow - Sales, Service, Industries, and Tableau Clouds

Manage inventory allocation for sales orders and work orders across multiple locations with accurate,
real-time visibility. View stock statuses, such as on-hand, allocated, and available, and soft-reserve
inventory for specific orders. Assign inventory to orders to prevent overcommitment and maintain
accurate inventory visibility, even during high-volume, concurrent transactions. This helps prevent stock
conflicts, improves tracking accuracy, and supports smarter, more efficient fulfillment decisions.

Where: This feature is available in Lightning Experience for Automotive, Communications, Energy and
Utilities, Manufacturing, and Media, where Asset Service Lifecycle Management is enabled.

Who: This feature is available to users with the Inventory Allocation and Inventory Search and Transfer
permission sets.

Why: Tracking only the total on-hand quantity is often insufficient and can lead to over-promising and
inaccurate order fulfillment. Allocating inventory with full visibility into inventory statuses allows you to



                                                      295
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                           Industries


clearly identify which portion of stock is truly available for new orders and which portion is already soft-
reserved for existing commitments. This improves order fulfillment accuracy and supports more reliable
operations.

How: Add the Inventory Allocation component to the Order and Work Order pages to view and create
allocations for products available as line items.

      Important This feature uses Einstein Generative AI and may consume Einstein Requests or Flex

How: Use these actions to manage timesheets within Agentforce.

• Create Timesheets and Timesheet Entries: Creates timesheets and entries for the current user.
    Categories for entries can be resolved to values such as WorkTime, DriveTime, BreakTime, and
    MealTime.
•   Verify Or Submit Timesheet: Initiates the process of verification or submission for a specific timesheet
    date.
•   Get Timesheet Details: Gets the main timesheet record, associated entries, and any unresolved
    validation errors for a selected date.

  and help finalize the funding for a customer’s loan or lease.

  reps had to clone a quote and then manually re-associate it with the correct opportunity in a separate
  step. Consolidating these actions streamlines the sales process and reduces data entry errors.
  Retain Original Asset Pricing During Modifications
  Preserve original asset prices during Move, Add, Change, Delete (MACD) operations in Enterprise Sales
  Management by defining attributes in Industries CPQ. Now, pricing calculations run only when you
  modify a price-impacting attribute, such as a manual override, applied discount, or quantity change.
  Updates to non-price attributes no longer trigger automatic repricing. Industries CPQ identifies these
  attributes via attribute-based pricing.
  Prevent Unnecessary Action Status Updates During MACD Operations
  Preserve the Existing status on asset line items when Move, Add, Change, Delete (MACD) rules update
  attribute properties without altering the actual values. Industries CPQ compares the original and
  current values so that only actual data modifications trigger a Change status. Previously, both value
  modifications and metadata changes triggered a status update to Change.
  Accelerate Sub-Order Creation with Scaled Batch Sizes
  Streamline your quote-to-order process by using scaled batch sizes to generate sub-orders faster within
  Enterprise Sales Management. Enable your sales reps to convert high-volume quotes efficiently while
  maintaining system stability and staying within query limits.
  Confirm Deletion of Quote Line Items in the Summary Tab
  The Summary tab prompts for confirmation when you delete a Quote Line Item in an Enterprise Sales
  quote. This step prevents accidental removal and confirms that the deletion is intentional.
  View Placeholders for Hidden Attributes in Enterprise Sales Quotes
  Get immediate context regarding attribute visibility in the Enterprise Sales Quote interface. When
  catalog configuration rules hide attributes, a placeholder UI label now appears rather than the fields
  disappearing. This UI label helps sales reps focus on customer-relevant data during the quoting
  process.
  Process Large Enterprise Quotes with Enhanced Stability
  Manage your large enterprise deals with a robust, optimized processing engine. Your sales reps can
  execute bulk Move, Add, Change, Delete (MACD) operations without timeouts or system instability.
  High-volume datasets previously caused transaction failures and governor limit errors, leading to
  breakdowns in the quoting workflow.

Customize Page Dimensions and Styles in Print Layout

This release is in preview

Note: This release is in preview. Features described in this document don't become generally available


                                                   334
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                         Industries


until the latest general availability date that Salesforce announces for this release. Before then, and
where features are noted as beta, pilot, or developer preview, we can't guarantee general availability
within any particular time frame or at all. Make your purchase decisions only on the basis of generally
available products and features.

Design custom page dimensions and override default formatting by using the styles node. The style
designed for a paragraph applies to all paragraph elements in the print layout. You can set the style name
to paragraph, table, tand headings. Specifying attributes such as font size, margin, bold, and italics is
optional.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Unlimited, Einstein 1, and Agentforce
1 editions with Consumer Goods Cloud.

How: Adapt PrintLayout V2 contracts with page dimensions or custom sizes with these standard formats
- A4 (default), A5, EXECUTIVE, FOLIO, LEGAL, LETTER, and TABLOID. You can now define pageSize with
an array of width and height in points, where 1 inch = 72 points. For example, pageSize="[216,
auto]" .

Customize or modify the default formatting in your print layouts with the styles node.


 ...
   <ReportLayout pageMargins="[5,5,5,5]" pageSize="[216, auto]">
     <styles>
       <style name="paragraph" fontSize="12" bold="true" />
       <style name="tableBody" margin="[0,2,0,2]" italics="true" />
     </styles>
 ...


The styles node configuration isn’t supported for Bluetooth thermal printers.




Other Improvements in Visual Studio Code Based Modeler

This release is in preview

Note: This release is in preview. Features described in this document don't become generally available
until the latest general availability date that Salesforce announces for this release. Before then, and
where features are noted as beta, pilot, or developer preview, we can't guarantee general availability
within any particular time frame or at all. Make your purchase decisions only on the basis of generally

The PDF preview now automatically splits content pages, improving readability without affecting thermal
printing. Adapt page layout rules to append more columns and apply center alignment. Configure day
and year values in correct formats for all supported languages.




                                                   335
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                         Industries


Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise and Unlimited editions with Consumer
Goods Cloud.

Why: Visual Studio Code Based Modeler offers these enhancements.

• PDF preview readability with auto-spilt pages: Content is now automatically split into pages in the
    preview. Previously, all content appeared on a single page when the PDF height was set to auto for
    3-inch Bluetooth thermal printers. This change makes it easier to read in the preview without affecting
    the actual thermal printing. See Considerations and Guidelines for Bluetooth Thermal Printer and Print
    Layout Setup.
•   Page layout rules and text alignment: Add more columns to your 3-inch PDF prints to create detailed
    and readable documents. You can set the minimum width requirement for <th> elements in the
    print layout upto 8%. You can also center align <th> elements. See Considerations and Guidelines
    for Bluetooth Thermal Printer and Print Layout Setup.


• International formatting in date selection - Configure the PickerDaySuffix and
    PickerYearSuffix attributes in your locale contract to show day and year values in correct format
    in the date wheel for all supported languages. See Localize Date, Time, and Numbers and DatePicker
    UI Control.
    For example, design your documents to cater to languages like Japanese that require "年" (Year) and
    "日" (Day) characters alongside numeric values.

     <PickerDaySuffix value="日"/>
     <PickerYearSuffix value="年"/>

Who: To use the Banking Service Customer Assistance template and agent topics, users need these
permission sets and permission set licenses.

• Salesforce Foundations Standard permission set
• Industry Service Excellence permission set
• Financial Services Cloud Extension, Financial Services Cloud Basic, Financial Services Cloud Service, or
    Financial Services Cloud Standard permission set license
•   Omnistudio User permission set
•   Business Rule Engine Runtime permission set

Why: Use the prebuilt agent topics included in the Banking Service Customer Assistance template.

• Address Update Request: Helps customers update their account-related and financial account-related
    addresses. Identifies and selects the specific address to change, gathers the new details, and creates a
    case for the update.
•   Financial Account Statement Request: Helps customers request copies of checking or savings account
    statements. Collects details regarding the specific account, statement period, and delivery method,
    and creates a case for fulfillment.
•   Financial Account Balances Request: Helps customers view the financial account balances associated
    with a specific account. Identifies the relevant financial account, and provides current details such as
    available and total balances.
•   Financial Account Transactions Request: Helps customers identify the relevant account, and shows the
    history including deposits, withdrawals, and payments.



                                                     349
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                           Industries


• Card Lock Management Request: Captures customers requests to lock or freeze a card temporarily or
    to unlock or reactivate a previously locked card.
• Funds Transfer to Own Account Request: Helps customers set up one-time or recurring fund transfers
    between savings and deposit accounts, including loan and credit card payments. Collects necessary
    payment details, and creates a case for the fund transfer.
•   Report Credit or Debit Card Request: Helps customers report their credit or debit card as lost, stolen,
    destroyed, or captured by an ATM. Shows the necessary card details, and creates a case to block the
    card to prevent unauthorized use.
•   Fee Reversal Request (beta): Helps customers reverse the fees charged to their financial accounts.
    Assists in identifying the specific transaction to reverse by showing relevant details, and submits the
    reversal request for processing.

How: To get started with Agentforce banking service for customers, complete the setup and
configuration for Banking Service Customer Assistance topics. Then, from Setup, turn on Einstein
generative AI from the Einstein setup page and Agentforce. Next, to set up a Banking Service Customer
Assistance agent, on the Agentforce Agents setup page, click New Agent. Then, select the Banking
Service Customer Assistance template in the Agent Builder.

New and Enhanced Common Features for Agentforce Health

Agentforce Health, formerly Health Cloud, includes access to some features that are available across
clouds and products in Industries. Use these features to extend and customize Agentforce Health based
on your business needs.

• Action Launcher
    Extend action recommendations by using contextual information from service records to determine
    user intent.
•   Action Plans
    Customize the quick actions on an action plan template record page. Include document checklist
    items in actions plans for financial accounts. Learn about the life events in a client’s household at a
    glance.
•   Actionable Relationship Center
    View many-to-one relationship type records on an Actionable Relationship Center (ARC) graph.
• Batch Management
    Use related object fields to control eligibility criteria and to group records for processing. Make the
    most of the new enhancements to fast-track batch job runs.
•   Business Rules Engine
    Experience improved scalability in decision tables with increased limits for invocations, output results,
    columns, and row processing. Expression sets enhancements include support for the IF function,
    automatic element naming, proactive alerts for constraint violations, and improved Salesforce Flow
    integration.
•   Criteria-Based Search and Filter
    Use Criteria-Based Search and Filter to design a search experience for your users. You can configure a
    search based on a single object that unifies complex sets of data, such as inventory and aggregated
    customer information that’s otherwise spread across multiple objects and fields. Criteria-Based Search
    and Filter can be customized to meet varied business requirements.
•   Data Processing Engine
    Preview how your definitions transform data and instantly validate and debug definition design right
    for the builder. Create and run definitions in Data 360 companion orgs. Use a unified view to track the
    performance and key metrics of definitions. Get actionable recommendations for failed runs and
    download failed records to debug faster. Find and focus the Data Processing Engine canvas on nodes
    that you want to work on.
•   Discovery Framework
    Easily present forms in the user's preferred language by storing assessment questions and responses in
    multiple languages. Save time by creating assessment questions with Generative AI so that you can
    generate, edit, and refine questions by using natural language instructions.
•   Omnistudio
    Use Omnistudio features to extend and customize your product based on your business needs.

  Use Digital Insurance Alongside the Insurance Managed Package or Insurance CRM
  Launch new products faster on the flexible Digital Insurance platform while you manage existing
  products, policies, and claims in the same org. Eliminate the overhead of administering separate orgs
  or rebuilding custom integrations extensively. Manage products, quotes, policies, and claims using
  solution-specific workflows and keep the transactional data, metadata, and automations segregated
  based on the originating solution. Although Digital Insurance can coexist with Insurance CRM or the
  Insurance managed package, these solutions don't interoperate.
  Accelerate Sales with Unified Multi-Root Insurance Quoting
  Create a single, comprehensive quote that includes multiple root products, such as Auto and Home.
  Captive agents can configure and price several products together and present them as a single
  offering. All lifecycle operations are managed at the parent policy level, and premiums and taxes
  aggregate from each child policy to deliver a consolidated financial overview. Use the multi-root
  issuance API (or invocable action) to create the parent and child policies upon quote acceptance.
  Manage subsequent renewals and endorsements at the parent policy level using the corresponding
  multi-root APIs or invocable actions.
  Manage Policy Lifecycle Better with Enhanced Versioning
  Optimize policy issuance, renewals, endorsements, and cancellations with complete versioning.
  Simplify the tracking of policy changes and mid-term adjustments during endorsements, helping
  service teams stay aligned with carrier updates.
  Agency Billing
  Manage the end-to-end agency billing workflow with greater accuracy, automation, and financial
  control across invoicing, payments, journals, and collections.
  Enable Comparative Rating and Multiple Plan Selection
  The Product Selection Lightning Web Component for Omnistudio allows end users to effortlessly
  compare multiple rated insurance products and choose the optimal plan directly within a guided
  Omniscript flow. Quickly compare up to three different root products side-by-side to understand
  variations in coverages and pricing. This component passes multiple rating inputs to the Insurance
  Rating API, which rates several root products and returns the calculated premiums and details. The UI
  displays product cards showing the premium and taxes for each option.
  Validate Complex Configurations with Constraint Rules Engine
  With Constraint Rules Engine (CRE), use constraint-based logic to validate complex product
  configurations. This feature supports deeply nested bundles, cross-product dependencies, and multi-
  instance insurance scenarios. CRE ensures accurate quoting by preventing invalid selections while you
  transition from Business Rules Engine to a constraint-driven model. For Insurance, Constraint Rules
  Engine is currently only supported for exclusions, clauses and configuration rules.
  Simplify Quoting and Policy Configuration through Guided Flows
  With the Product Configuration Lightning Web Component, users can immediately see how policy
  attribute changes affect the premium, enabling efficient, real-time quote generation. This component
  for Omnistudio accepts multiple rating inputs and calls the Insurance Rating POST and PATCH APIs to
  update attribute values for specific coverages.
  Track Policy Limits with Flexible Duration Types


                                                  389
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                            Industries


  Reset policy limits at the end of a calendar year or on a specific override date, or enforce lifetime limits
  that don’t reset. Previously, you could only reset limits at the end of a policy term.
  Cap Payments at the Lowest Limit for Loss Claims
  Adjusters can now determine the correct payable amount without manual calculations before they
  request approvals. Enforce the lowest remaining limit, and track consumption across sub-coverage,
  coverage, and policy levels for loss-type payments. Prevent failed payments, recalculations, and messy
  audit trails.
  Revise Claim Coverage Payment Details to Make Corrections
  Edit details such as the payee or the claim amount for a claim coverage payment. Calculate the new
  adjusted amount and update the limit tracking for accurate audit trails. Previously, you deleted a claim
  coverage payment detail record and created a new one to update details.
  Issue Ex Gratia Payments for Loss Claims
  Authorize exceptional payments for loss claims that exceed the policy or coverage limits. Track ex
  gratia payments for auditability while capping consumption at the remaining limit. Handle special
  circumstances and maintain positive customer relations without manual workarounds or negative
  balances.
  Copy Data Between Nodes in a Pricing Procedure
  Gather the required data for price calculations by copying attributes to a node from its parent, child, or
  other related nodes. Previously, you could only aggregate numerical attributes from related nodes as a
  workaround but couldn’t access the text attributes. For example, when calculating the premium for
  collision coverage, add attributes from the product, vehicle, and driver nodes to the coverage node to
  compile the data for the calculation.

  Do more with the new and updated Insurance objects.

        Use the new ProductSellingModel field on the InsurancePolicyParticipant object.

        Use the new BillingTreatment field on the InsurancePolicyParticipant object.

        Use the new PriorParticipant field on the InsurancePolicyParticipant object.

        Use the new ProductSellingModel field on the InsurancePolicyCoverage object.

        Use the new BillingTreatment field on the InsurancePolicyCoverage object.


Track the reference surcharge record before the policy was endorsed or renewed.
        Use the new PriorCoverage field on the InsurancePolicyCoverage object.

Give your users increased flexibility to adjust their activity plans. Track goal measures for a wider range of
activities. Use new trigger handlers to update your activity plan goals and apply adjustment creation
limits.

    Make Quick, Ad Hoc Adjustments to Your Activity Plans
    Gain greater adaptability and flexibility in reaching your targets by submitting activity plan adjustment
    requests. Track activity types for accounts that aren't in your plan or set goals to track more activity
    types for your existing accounts. Revise the goal metrics to account for last-minute changes and
    remove accounts that can no longer be accommodated. Easily modify goals and enforce request
    creation limits by using new trigger handlers.
    Achieve More Personalization with the Updated Activity Measure Workflow
    Evaluate goal metrics beyond visit-related activities with the enhanced activity measure workflow.
    Choose from a wider range of custom and standard objects to monitor your business-specific
    activities. Also, Activity Type Field and Activity Type Field Value are no longer mandatory for tracking
    metrics, helping you plan activities quickly without having to provide additional details.

Plan and run customer engagements more efficiently with improved remote engagement as well as
desktop and new AI features. Expand your remote engagement capabilities by conducting visits through
Microsoft Teams and automatically capturing key details. Shape strategies and drive informed execution
by capturing field observations and validating them through collaborative insights. Manage visit records
from the new Visit List and see which attendees primary account addresses match the visit location in
the Attendees sidebar. Also, you can now open presentations and track engagement directly from the
desktop Visit Engagement page. Sales reps and service agents can streamline workflows by managing
visits within the Salesforce Service Console, alongside related records like accounts, cases, and medical
inquiries.

  Shape Strategies by Using Collaborative Medical Insights
  Capture observations directly from field interactions in the Life Sciences Cloud mobile app to
  understand trends and guide engagement strategies. Validate findings through peer upvoting and
  hierarchical grouping to make sure that high-priority concerns surface quickly. Drive informed
  execution plans in your team by using insights and shared knowledge to identify opportunities and
  mitigate risks effectively.
  View Attendees with the Same Address Attendees in the Sidebar
  Quickly identify attendees linked to the same address by enabling Same-Address Attendees in the
  Attendee sidebar. When enabled, you can see at a glance which attendees share the same primary
  account addresses as the visit location.
  Manage Visit Records in One Place
  Use the new Visit List View, available on the Visit tab, to manage schedules and record keeping. Sort,
  search, and filter upcoming visit records. You can also add samples and create new visits directly from
  a list view card.
  Start Presentations and Track Engagement from Visits on the Desktop Site
  Your field users can now start presentations from the Visit Engagement page and navigate between
  the presentation player and the visit on the desktop site. Metrics about the slides presented and the
  linked products and messages are captured on the Visit Engagement page automatically, providing a



                                                   408
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                               Industries


    more consistent experience. Previously, field users could conduct presentations and track engagement
    data from visits only in the Life Sciences Cloud mobile app.
    Manage Visits from the Service Console
    Sales reps and service agents no longer have to switch between windows to manage visits. You can
    now work with Visits directly in the Salesforce Service Console. Open Visits alongside accounts, cases,
    and medical inquiries, switch between records without losing context, and use quick actions to
    navigate between Visit sections and related records, such as Medical Inquiries and Expenses.
    Filter Admin Console Tiles Based on User Permissions
    Show users only the tiles they need in the Admin Console by turning on Filter Admin Console Tiles
    Based On User Permissions. Use Life Sciences Customer Engagement Setup to make the change.
    Changes to Trigger Handlers
    The trigger handlers VisitConflictValidationHandler and DeleteVisitStdEventHandler are no longer
    available.

Intelligent Content

This release is in preview

Note: This release is in preview. Features described in this document don't become generally available
until the latest general availability date that Salesforce announces for this release. Before then, and
where features are noted as beta, pilot, or developer preview, we can't guarantee general availability

Expand your search beyond just presentation names and metadata properties by searching within
presentation content. Share presentations with healthcare professionals as unique links instead of as
email attachments.

    Share Presentations as Unique Email Links
    Maximize the impact of your content by enabling field users to send presentations as links in
    preapproved email templates. By using email links, healthcare professionals (HCPs) can view content
    in a dedicated portal without downloading email attachments. Manage when presentations are
    available so that HCPs always see the most up-to-date content, and maintain access controls by
    defining when links expire. Use rich engagement data—including pages viewed, time spent per page,
    and the HCP’s navigation path—to optimize presentations for future engagements.



                                                    412
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                          Industries


    Use Smart Content Search to Find Relevant Presentations
    Improve the quality of your search results by using Data 360 to create a search index of the content in
    presentation files. While online, field users can search for presentations by using either keywords or
    conceptual terms and phrases, making it easier to find the most relevant materials. Previously, search
    results included only standard keyword-based matches on presentation names and metadata
    properties.

New and Enhanced Common Features for Manufacturing

Manufacturing includes access to some features that are available across clouds and products in
Industries. Use these features to extend and customize Manufacturing Cloud based on your business
needs.

• Action Launcher
    Make recommendations available in companion orgs to help teams quickly resolve customer issues.
    Deploy file-based data kits to configure Recommended Actions.
•   Asset Service Lifecycle Management
    Quickly find and manage inventory with enhanced batch-level details and search capabilities,
    improving accuracy and streamlining your inventory processes. Timesheet and labor cost
    enhancements simplify time tracking, bulk entries, shift differential management, and error correction
    on mobile devices.
•   Business Rule Engine
    Build more granular business-specific configurations by further categorizing Usage Types available in
    your Salesforce product into Usage Subtypes. Usage Subtype values are available to you depending on
    your industry solution and permission sets. Asynchronous processes in decision tables now create
    events when they are completed.
•   Connected Assets
    Connect, monitor, and control assets in real time to drive smarter service operations. Define asset
    structures, collect telemetry data, trigger remote actions, and integrate with Digital Twin to optimize
    performance, reduce downtime, and enable proactive service delivery.
•   Context Service
    Sort and filter data with context filters to retrieve precise and contextually relevant data with dynamic
    data filters in Context Service. Ensure continuous data flow across applications by modifying mappings
    without deactivating context definitions. The Time To Live (TTL) value of context instances created by
    Apex and flows is set to 10 seconds instead of 30 seconds.
•   Data Processing Engine
    DPE now offers a debugging feature in beta for CRMA jobs, providing enhanced visibility into failures
    and outputs to empower users and reduce support reliance. Write back transformed data directly to
    data model objects (DMOs) using the Data Cloud runtime, with options to create DMOs and validate
    data types. Writeback nodes are updated to support upserting records with an External ID, improving
    data sync across different systems. Three new formula functions have been added to give you more
    control and flexibility in data transformation. The Data Cloud runtime now includes functionality such
    as composite and custom nodes, the ability to write back to new DLOs, and a debug mode for saving
    node output record counts.

  Sales Agreement data grid. Users can filter by product lines, schedules, and any field corresponding to
  Sales Agreement Product Schedules, including custom fields, to view only the data most relevant to
  their updates. This improvement supports faster navigation, more targeted updates, and greater
  efficiency when working with Sales Agreements.

Manage inventory allocation for sales orders and work orders across multiple locations with accurate,
real-time visibility. View stock statuses, such as on-hand, allocated, and available, and soft-reserve
inventory for specific orders. Assign inventory to orders to prevent overcommitment, and maintain
accurate inventory visibility, even during high-volume, concurrent transactions. This helps prevent stock
conflicts, improves tracking accuracy, and supports smarter, more efficient fulfillment decisions.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer editions
with Manufacturing enabled.

Who: This feature is available to users with the Inventory Allocation and Inventory Search and Transfer
permission sets.

Why: Tracking only the total on-hand quantity is often insufficient and can lead to over-promising and
inaccurate order fulfillment. Allocating inventory with full visibility into inventory statuses allows you to
clearly identify which portion of stock is truly available for new orders and which portion is already soft-
reserved for existing commitments. This improves order fulfillment accuracy and supports more reliable
operations.

How: Add the Inventory Allocation component to the Order and Work Order pages to view and create
allocations for products available as line items.

New Objects

Represent information about the status of the inventory reservations.
       Use the new Inventory Reservation object.


Represent inventory item reservation information for a specific product and location.
       Use the new Inventory Item Reservation object.


Represent an individual transaction that records a change in the state and quantity of a specific
product item.
       Use the new Product Item Additional Transaction object.


Represent a request for product samples, including customer account details, request date, and
status.
        Use the new Sample Request object.


Represent sample or custom specification details associated with a sample request, including
quantity, price, and cost information.
        Use the new Sample Request Item object.


Represent a complete set of product requirements, including associated account and contact
information, lifecycle status, and relationships to requirement items and their versions.
       Use the new Product Requirement Specification object.


Represent a specific, measurable requirement within a requirement specification, defining delivery
expectations and verification criteria for a requested product.
       Use the new Product Requirement Specification Item object.


Represent a specific version of a requirement specification, capturing its purpose, scope, constraints,
and validation methods at a given point in time.
        Use the new Product Requirement Specification Version object.


Changed Objects

Store the quantity of product items that are allocated but not yet shipped.
        Use the new field Quantity Allocated on Product Item.


Store the quantity of product items that are currently available in inventory.
        Use the new field Quantity Available on Product Item.

Salesforce Release Notes                                                                            Industries


Store the date and time when the quantity status of the product item was last updated.
        Use the new field Quantity State Refresh Date on Product Item.

Connect REST API Enhancements

Availability Status Mapping
        Added ratio-based AvailabilityStatus mapping through AdAvailsConfig to set the status and icon
        on AdQuoteLine.




                                                    438
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                         Industries


Targeting Inclusion Flag
        Added isIncluded (true/false) support to include or exclude targeting in MuleSoft Direct for
        Google Ad Manager.


Ad Space Group Support
       Added isGroup (true/false) to adSpaceSpecifications. Mule maps it
       to adUnitId or targetedPlacementIds, and ASM maps identifiers to adUnitId (Ad Space) or
       placement_id (Ad Space Group).


Postal Code Targeting
        Added postal code support to targeting in API specifications. Mule maps the postal codes to
        Google Ad Manager geoTargeting.


MaxDuration and Skippable Support
        Added MaxDuration and Skippable for video/audio AdQuoteLine items. The UI captures these
        values, and the API sends them as digitalAttributes.

New APIs in Agentforce Public Sector

This release is in preview

Note: This release is in preview. Features described in this document don't become generally available

Do more with the new API in Agentforce Public Sector, formerly Public Sector Solutions, objects.

Support for Regulatory Transaction Fee (RTF) Adjustments and Refunds

        The Recompute API is used when fees are recomputed, disputed, or cancelled. The adjustments
        to the existing Regulatory Transaction Fees (RTFs) can be positive or negative. For fee corrections,
        it automatically creates a new RTF against the original RTF and a corresponding new invoice for
        the adjusted amount. The original RTF is always set as the parent of the new RTF record. There
        are two types of adjustments:

     • Positive adjustments: Creates a new RTF and a new invoice for the additional fee.
     • Negative adjustments: Creates a new negative RTF and a new invoice, automatically generates a
        credit memo against the original invoice, adjusts payments, and processes a refund.

student success, advancement, and alumni engagement with the latest CRM and student information
system (SIS) capabilities.

  Agentforce for Education
  Streamline student financial management, offer autonomous transfer credit estimates, strengthen
  prospect research strategy, and centralize course collaboration within Slack.



                                                   458
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                            Industries


  Streamline Transfer Credit Evaluations for Students
  Create and manage transfer equivalency relationships and the entire transfer credit process from a
  unified interface that automatically matches and suggests credits. Registrars can use the guided
  process to review submitted documentation and to articulate credit transfer requests.
  Accelerate Transfer Credit Evaluations in the Application Process
  Speed up learning equivalency evaluations and reduce student wait time by requesting estimates for
  transferable credits directly in the application portal. Applicants can enter details of prior learning and
  upload supporting documents and images in each admissions application. They can also reuse
  previous estimates to prefill and create official transfer credit requests. When an applicant submits
  their information, automatically create records and streamline the review process.
  Help Students Register for High-Demand Courses Efficiently
  Configure course waitlists to simplify the enrollment process and manage the demand for popular
  courses. Support students to join the waitlists of high-demand courses directly from the Experience
  Cloud site and notify them when seats open up, reducing the stress of monitoring course availability.
  Determine student enrollment priority and timing on a dedicated setup page. Send enrollment offers
  to students by using prebuilt flows. Students can accept or decline an offer to enroll, or remove
  themselves from waitlists.
  Configure Educational Characteristics to Enforce Eligibility Checks During Course Registration
  Clearly communicate eligibility criteria to students during course registration. Configure complex
  eligibility logic on learning courses by using a flexible and scalable framework. Define and assign
  identity-based attributes to students, such as major, cohort, or honors status, that tie to specific time
  frames. Automatically evaluate student attributes against eligibility criteria to enforce enrollment rules.
  Show students the required educational characteristics of each course to help them make informed
  decisions. Maintain accurate enrollment data and comply with institutional policies.
  Simplify Appointment Scheduling Setup in Agentforce Education
  System administrators get clear guidance at every stage to quickly set up appointment scheduling
  topics, assign staff, and complete all prerequisite steps. This feature drastically cuts down on
  configuration time and reduces errors. Staff members now have a simplified experience to manage
  their own and their colleagues’ availability with a few clicks. Institutions can configure scheduling
  quickly and accurately by using intuitive guidance and education-aligned language.
  Gain Trusted Education Insights with a Unified Semantic Layer
  Use the Tableau Semantic Layer to organize your data into a single, reusable model. This shared layer
  calculates metrics consistently across Tableau Next components, Agents, and Marketing Cloud Growth
  campaigns. With one trusted source of truth, teams can analyze performance, generate data, and
  make decisions with confidence.
  Empower Advisors to Help Students with Personalized Career and Goal Planning
  Provide personalized guidance and help students define and achieve career and life goals. Advisors
  can access the involvement groups and a library of career and interest assessments. They can
  recommend the right fit to students based on the student's profile, preferences, assessment insights,
  and so on.
  Enhance the Efficiency of Academic Petitions and Waivers
  Easily create and manage academic petitions and waivers with an intuitive form builder and
  configurable approval workflows. Centralizing tracking and outcome management reduces manual



                                                    459
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                          Industries


  errors and ensures a smoother process for administrators, students, and faculty or staff.
  Explore Learning Programs and Request Details Directly in Campus and Program Finder
  Make the request for learning program information intuitive. Create a card view for learning programs
  in Campus and Program Finder. Provide a button for applicants, students, and families to request
  more information about specific learning programs conveniently.
  Support Applicants to Sign and Manage Their Application Submissions
  Add control and flexibility to your dynamic admissions applications. Give applicants the option to
  digitally sign their applications when they’re ready to submit. Offer the flexibility to cancel
  unsubmitted applications and withdraw submitted ones.
  Use Tailored Gift Visualizations for Each Planned Gift Type
  Access eight dynamic visualizations that automatically adapt to the structure of each planned gift type
  using Flexcards in the Gift Planning app. These Flexcards present the most important details at a
  glance, helping relationship officers quickly assess value, timelines, and stewardship needs. Select a
  gift type to get a layout that shows only the fields that matter, streamlining review and data entry.
  Enhance Agentforce Education Feature Configuration and Setup
  Discover and find configuration instructions for a broader range of Education features in Salesforce Go.

  content resources and links.

New and Enhanced Common Features for Agentforce Education

Agentforce Education, formerly Education Cloud, includes access to some features that are available
across clouds and products in Industries. Use these features to extend and customize Education Cloud
based on your business needs.

• Fundraising
  Give your staff and donors powerful tools for managing gifts. Donors can handle common requests,
  like changing recurring gifts, by using the self-service Donor Support Agent (Beta). Free up your staff by
  customizing the Gift Entry grid with templates and custom Lightning Web Components for faster
  processing. You can now add up to 50 designations to a single gift and backdate transactions for gift
  commitments, all from within the Gift Entry Grid. New object updates also help you track in-kind
  donations and add multiple designations. Streamline workflows, improve data accuracy, and provide
  Relationship Officers with clear, gift-specific views, with dynamic page layouts for gift planning.

  Streamline Student Financials with Agentforce
  Help students efficiently manage their accounts with the Student Financials Agent, which includes

  agent to view their current balances, ask for fee breakdowns, and request more information about
  specific fees.

  Help prospective students with application decisions by making transfer credit estimates readily
  accessible in the Transfer Credit Agent (beta). Estimate credits that are transferable into an institution
  or learning programs right in an agent session to reduce response time for evaluations. Save previous
  estimates to give students continuous access.
  Strengthen Prospect Strategy by Creating Slack Research Channels and Canvases with Agentforce
  Integrate research workflows directly with Slack to accelerate decision making and improve
  collaboration across advancement teams. Give researchers and relationship officers a shared space to
  evaluate high-impact prospects. Researchers can build channels, publish canvases, and produce
  insights without leaving Slack. Relationship officers can join prospect-specific channels and review
  curated canvases.
  Centralize Course Collaboration in Slack with Agentforce
  Manage Course Operations workflows in Slack with Agentforce. Faculty can create channels for each
  course offering, maintain accurate participant lists, and publish a syllabus canvas in the same space
  where communication already happens. Real-time updates and easier access to course resources
  provide students with a unified academic experience.

New and Changed Objects in Agentforce Education

This release is in preview



                                                    471
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                         Industries


Note: This release is in preview. Features described in this document don't become generally available
until the latest general availability date that Salesforce announces for this release. Before then, and
where features are noted as beta, pilot, or developer preview, we can't guarantee general availability
within any particular time frame or at all. Make your purchase decisions only on the basis of generally
available products and features.

Do more with the new and updated Education objects.


     Note Education Cloud is now Agentforce Education. You may see references to Education Cloud in
     our application and documentation.

Represent a junction between an academic interval, such as an academic term, and an order
       Use the new AcademicOrder object.


Represent a characteristic about a student such as the student's major or student-athlete status
        Use the new EducationalCharacteristic object.


Represent the assignment of an educational characteristic to a student. Assignments are active for
an academic interval such as an academic year or semester
       Use the new EducCharacteristicAssignment object.


Represent a category of educational characteristics such as major or campus
       Use the new EducCharacteristicType object.


Represent the assignment of an educational characteristic requirement to a learning or course
offering
        Use the new EducCharReqAssignment object.


Represent the logic between multiple educational characteristics that defines an educational
characteristic requirement
       Use the new EducCharReqRelationship object.


Represent a definition of the educational characteristics that are needed to meet an educational
requirement
       Use the new EducCharRequirement object.


Represent the configuration for Course Waitlists
       Use the new CourseWaitlistConfig object.


Represent a junction between a price book and an academic interval such as an academic term
       Use the new PriceBookAcademicInterval object.


Represent the evaluation of a learner's prior learning that can be used for a transfer
       Use the new PriorLearningEvaluation object.



                                                   472
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                         Industries


Represent more details of a course credit transfer application
       Use the new IndividualApplication , IsLearningInProgress , CreditType ,
         IsForEstimation , LearningStartDate , LearningEndDate , and
         PriorLearningEval fields on the existing CourseCreditTransferAppln object.

View many-to-one relationship type records on an Actionable Relationship Center (ARC) graph.

  Visualize More Relationships on an ARC Graph
  Show records related to each other via a many-to-one relationship type in ARC. The many-to-one
  relationship type uses a lookup relationship to link many records from an object to a single record
  from another object. In ARC, it shows a lookup field from the child node to the parent node. You can
  add one-to-many or many-to-many nodes to the child node. Previously, you could create an ARC graph
  by using only one-to-many or many-to-many relationship types.

  Optimize batch job filters with conditions that use related object fields to make sure jobs process only

  processes records with common dependencies together. For example, you can group quotes by their

  Monitor Record Group Counts for Composite Writeback
  Monitor Workflow Services shows the aggregated count of input, output, and failed record groups for
  Composite Writeback nodes. Record group counts from child tasks roll up to the node's parent task.
  Unlike tasks for other nodes, Composite Writeback tasks track record groups generated by the node's
  grouping logic.

  Use advanced search in the Data Processing Engine builder to jump to the node you want to review or

  Enable streamlined order operations by connecting Industries CPQ with Dynamic Revenue
  Orchestrator (DRO) within a unified platform. This integration supports existing Enterprise Product
  Catalog (EPC) structures, without the need for commercial and technical catalog migration. The DRO
  system facilitates fulfillment by decomposing complex products into technical products based on
  attribute rules, product hierarchies, custom order fields, and defined decomposition relationships. Use
  the DRO Decomposition and Fulfillment workspace to streamline your entire order lifecycle by creating
  detailed, end-to-end orchestration plans. Gain full control over complex scenarios as DRO efficiently

  priorities.

  Provide an improved user experience for your Industries CPQ Cart with large product bundles with

  Provide an effortless user experience in the Industries CPQ cart operations. Guarantee uninterrupted

  Get Pricing Benefits by Retaining Original Asset Price in Standard Cart APIs
  Provide an elevated user experience by retaining the original contract price. Retain the pricing

Preserve the Existing status on asset line items when Move, Add, Change, Delete (MACD) rules update
attribute properties without altering the actual values. Industries CPQ compares original and current

processing errors in downstream Order Management systems.

configure and use Standard Cart APIs.

Process Compliance Navigator

This release is in preview

Note: This release is in preview. Features described in this document don't become generally available
until the latest general availability date that Salesforce announces for this release. Before then, and
where features are noted as beta, pilot, or developer preview, we can't guarantee general availability
within any particular time frame or at all. Make your purchase decisions only on the basis of generally
available products and features.

Use Process Compliance Navigator to ensure your organization meets regulatory requirements, internal
policies, and industry standards. Compliance governance is strengthened with new validation criteria
enforcing auditable transitions for controls, regulations, and policies, ensuring consistent evidence.
Efficiency is improved by using context definitions for streamlined data access in validation and
Compliant Data Sharing for records.

  Control Compliance Record Access by Using Compliant Data Sharing
  Record owners in organizations with strict sharing policies can now grant other users access to their
  records by using Compliant Data Sharing for Process Compliance Navigator. Define record sharing
  rules for your compliance users so that record owners can share business operations processes,
  compliance policies, compliance regulations, compliance controls, and validation procedures with
  participant groups and participant roles.
  Achieve Audit Readiness with Compliance Control Testing
  Verify that your compliance controls are successfully mitigating risks and enforcing regulations and
  policies with compliance testing. This testing evaluates a control’s operating effectiveness, confirms its
  design function, and captures verifiable evidence during the execution of the test. Use these details to
  demonstrate to regulators and auditors that your compliance program works as intended.
  Enforce Compliance Control Testing Status Transition and Validation Criteria
  Strengthen your compliance framework and create an audit trail with the new Compliance Control
  Testing Status Transition and Validation Criteria setting. This setting enhances data governance by
  enforcing mandatory validation and transition rules whenever a user modifies the status of a
  Compliance Control Version Test Execution record. By locking down key attributes and transitions, this
  setting prevents the creation of inconsistent or unverifiable test evidence. For example, when the
  setting is turned on, enforce a rule that if the execution status is completed, a user can’t update it to a
  different value.
  Streamline Data Access with Context Definitions
  Define business context in your validation procedures with context definitions. A context definition
  acts as a structured data layer and translator that organizes data so that you can easily map and access
  relevant information across multiple objects. For example, to enforce compliance and prevent
  customer harassment, debt collection agencies must follow regulations that limit the number of times
  that they can call a customer. By using a context definition, you can now validate contact data, such as
  call frequency and time zone fields, before an agent initiates a call. The validation procedure passes in


                                                    525
Salesforce Release Notes                                                                           Industries


  contact record data to validate it for compliance, ensuring agents adhere to all call limitations.
  Clarify Purpose with the Renamed Logged-in User Locale Setting
  To ensure clarity and better reflect its purpose, the User Locale setting is now named Logged-in User
  Locale. This setting uses the logged-in user’s locale when logging API messages for Business Rules
  Engine compliance controls. Previously, this setting was called User Locale.
  Enforce Validation Criteria for Regulations and Policies
  Maintain an auditable and compliant lifecycle for managing your organization’s regulations and
  internal policies by using the Regulation and Policy Status Transition and Validation Criteria setting.
  Acting as a governance gatekeeper for compliance officers, the setting enforces criteria before
  updating regulation version or compliance policy version.
  Track Policies and Regulations that Govern Your Assets
  Improve the traceability of your regulated hardware and software assets by mapping regulation clause
  versions, compliance policy clause versions, and compliance control versions to an asset. Use this
  structure to maintain a record of the policies and regulations governing your assets, visualize control
  relationships, report on coverage gaps, and demonstrate adequate control implementation for
  compliance.
  New Agentforce Process Compliance Navigator Jumpstart Bundles
  Quickly get started with Agentforce Process Compliance Navigator by using preconfigured features and
  flows designed to reduce setup time and complexity.
  New Objects in Process Compliance Navigator
  Do more with these new and updated Process Compliance Navigator objects.

policies by using the Regulation and Policy Status Transition and Validation Criteria setting. Acting as a
governance gatekeeper for compliance officers, the setting enforces criteria before updating regulation
version or compliance policy version.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Developer, Enterprise, and Unlimited editions
with Process Compliance Navigator.

Why: This setting prevents premature activation or incorrect retirement of rules so that your organization
always operates on the legally effective version of a regulation or policy. For example, you can publish a
regulation version only when all of the associated regulation clause versions are published or active.
Previously, users could update the status field on the regulation version or compliance policy version
without enforced transition and validation criteria.

How: From Setup, select Compliance, and then select Regulation and Policy Status Transition and
Validation Criteria.

Google Adds “via” Tag to System Emails

This release is in preview

Note: This release is in preview. Features described in this document don't become generally available
until the latest general availability date that Salesforce announces for this release. Before then, and
where features are noted as beta, pilot, or developer preview, we can't guarantee general availability
within any particular time frame or at all. Make your purchase decisions only on the basis of generally
available products and features.

System emails that are sent to Google Group email addresses now include a "via" tag in the From
address.

The “via” tag is a security feature that’s added to a message sent on behalf of another sender or
domain—in this case, a message from info@pardot.com for your domain. This tag helps prevent email
spoofing and enhances security so that recipients can identify an email’s true origin.

• Old Format—Marketing Cloud Account Engagement <info@pardot.com>
• New Format—“‛Marketing Cloud Account Engagement’ via Group-Name”
  <YourGroup@Yourdomain.com>

Where: This change applies to Salesforce Enterprise, Performance, and Unlimited editions with any
Marketing Cloud Account Engagement edition.

When: This change began on October 11, 2025.

SEE ALSO | Salesforce Help: System Emails (can be outdated or unavailable during release preview)

  The new 7-day retry window prevents users from experiencing dropped batches due to unsuccessful
  delivery attempts. When a batch of notification events fails to deliver, ENS retries delivery at periodic,
  decreasing intervals for up to 7 days. After that, retries stop and delivery fails. Previously, ENS
  suspended callback URLs immediately after a failed delivery.
